payload.purpose_context: Reviewers today can end up with a work package whose recorded verdict disagrees with what actually happened, in five distinct ways: an approval committed before the transition runs, an approval fabricated from a deliberate arbiter waiver, an approval skipped entirely because two components resolve the artifact directory differently, an approval written but never git-committed, and a review that cannot start at all because a written lane event is not read back. Each is currently defended against separately. This mission rebuilds the write seam so those states are structurally unrepresentable rather than individually guarded, and retires the duplicated writers, resolvers and frontmatter readers that let them arise.
payload.purpose_tldr: Make a recorded review verdict and a completed lane transition the same event, so an approval can never be lost, fabricated, or silently left uncommitted.
